annotations.title: Keyword alert check: how many matching items in the last N hours

description:
Keyword alert check: how many matching items in the last N hours. Count of news matching q (same matching as /news/search) published in the last N hours (1-168, default 24), plus the 5 most recent

GET /news/alerts/check — price $0.004 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, clamped to 1-168) Default: 24.

q.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

name: check_news_alert
title: Keyword alert check: how many matching items in the last N hours
